note: Display metadata for scenes added from gallery-sources.json. Credits and licenses are as published by the source on the verification date; titles and descriptions are ours.

scenes.title: Perito Moreno Glacier
scenes.description: North panorama of the Perito Moreno Glacier, Argentina, January 2010. Published JPEG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.

scenes.title: Mount St. Helens summit
scenes.description: 360° panorama from the summit of Mount St. Helens, October 2009. Published JPEG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.
scenes.thumbnailAlt: Mount St. Helens summit panorama preview

scenes.title: Colca Valley terraces
scenes.description: Ancient terraces of the Colca Valley, Peru, June 2010. Assembled without resampling from the author's six published full-size parts (a 3 × 2 grid), not from the recompressed single file.

scenes.title: Zabriskie Point badlands
scenes.description: Badlands from Zabriskie Point, Death Valley National Park, California. Published JPEG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.

scenes.title: Alabama Hills
scenes.description: 216-megapixel panorama of the Alabama Hills and the Sierra Nevada near Lone Pine, California. Published JPEG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.

scenes.title: Google/SkyWater wafer
scenes.description: Stitched microscope image of an open-source Google/SkyWater multi-project wafer. Published JPEG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.

scenes.title: Emperor Taizong Receiving the Tibetan Envoy
scenes.description: Scan of the handscroll attributed to Yan Liben. Published PNG, 143,397 × 9,399, decoded to RGB8 without resampling.
scenes.thumbnailAlt: Handscroll Emperor Taizong Receiving the Tibetan Envoy preview
scenes.credit: Yan Liben (Tang dynasty) · scan via the Palace Museum, Beijing, as credited on Wikimedia Commons

scenes.title: Virgo Cluster
scenes.description: Rubin Observatory image of the Virgo Cluster (NOIRLab's “The Cosmic Treasure Chest”), 97,943 × 51,536 pixels, from the full-size original TIFF. The embedded Adobe RGB (1998) profile is converted to sRGB; no upscaling. A published rendering, not raw detector data.

scenes.title: Eagle, Omega and Sharpless 2-54 nebulae
scenes.description: ESO's three-gigapixel VLT Survey Telescope (VST) image of the Eagle, Omega and Sharpless 2-54 nebulae, 93,031 × 35,412 pixels, from the full-size original PSB. The embedded L* RGB profile is converted to sRGB; no upscaling. A published rendering, not raw detector data.
scenes.thumbnailAlt: Eagle, Omega and Sharpless 2-54 nebulae preview

scenes.title: Blue Marble · Complete globe
scenes.description: NASA's complete July Blue Marble Next Generation globe with topography, 86,400 × 43,200 pixels at 500 m, assembled without resampling from its eight published 21,600-pixel tiles. Not the topography-plus-bathymetry variant used by the western-hemisphere view.

scenes.title: Big Pine Ledge reef, Florida
scenes.description: A 5-millimeter underwater orthomosaic of Big Pine Ledge in the Florida Keys, 175,400 × 56,600 pixels (9.9 gigapixels), from USGS's cloud-optimized GeoTIFF. Areas outside the survey are transparent in the source and shown black here. Not for navigation.
scenes.thumbnailAlt: Big Pine Ledge coral reef orthomosaic preview
scenes.credit: U.S. Geological Survey · Kranenburg, Hatcher and Warrick (2024), DOI 10.5066/P9H0Q773

scenes.title: IC 348 star cluster
scenes.description: Webb NIRCam near-infrared view of IC 348, a young star cluster in Perseus about 1,000 light-years away, 30,866 × 38,204 pixels. Composite of four filters (F162M, F182M, F360M, F444W). Published PNG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.
scenes.credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, Kevin Luhman (PSU), Catarina Alves de Oliveira (ESA), Mahdi Zamani (ESA/Webb)

scenes.title: NGC 7129 star-forming region
scenes.description: Webb NIRCam image of NGC 7129, a star-forming region in Cepheus about 3,300 light-years away, 11,958 × 11,156 pixels. Published PNG decoded to RGB8; no upscaling.
scenes.credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; Alyssa Pagan (STScI)

scenes.title: Andromeda Galaxy (PHAT mosaic)
scenes.description: The largest Hubble image of the Andromeda Galaxy (M31), 69,536 × 22,230 pixels, from the full-size original PSB. Over 100 million stars across about 40,000 light-years. The embedded ICC profile is converted to sRGB; no upscaling.
scenes.credit: NASA, ESA, J. Dalcanton, B.F. Williams, L.C. Johnson (U. Washington), the PHAT team, and R. Gendler

scenes.title: Triangulum Galaxy M33
scenes.description: Hubble mosaic of the Triangulum Galaxy (M33), 34,372 × 19,345 pixels, from the full-size original TIFF. About 54 ACS pointings covering the central region and inner spiral arms. No upscaling.
scenes.credit: NASA, ESA, and M. Durbin, J. Dalcanton, and B.F. Williams (U. Washington)

scenes.title: Carina Nebula
scenes.description: Hubble 48-frame ACS mosaic of the Carina Nebula, 29,566 × 14,321 pixels, from the full-size original TIFF. Ionized hydrogen image with Cerro Tololo colour data. No upscaling.
scenes.credit: NASA, ESA, N. Smith (UC Berkeley), and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)

scenes.title: NGC 2014 and NGC 2020 starbirth
scenes.description: Hubble 30th-anniversary image of NGC 2014 and NGC 2020 in the Large Magellanic Cloud, 17,043 × 11,710 pixels, from the full-size original TIFF. No upscaling.
